test_render_from_depth_osmesa: test the OSMesa renderer by rendering from a depth map and comparing against ground truth color
run_tacto_renderer_from_depth: run the tacto Renderer to render color and depth from a depth map with a given scale
create_tacto_renderer: create a tacto Renderer with specified width, height, config path, and background settings
